note: Buyer-typed prompts for the Microsoft Copilot alternative question. Add a prompt only when a buyer would type it; never to make a product appear. Changing a prompt invalidates comparison with earlier runs, so add with a new id instead of editing an existing one.

prompts.text: What is the best open source alternative to Microsoft Copilot for a company that wants to run it itself?
We build agents in Copilot Studio and the credit bill is unpredictable. What should we switch to?
Microsoft 365 Copilot vs Onyx for enterprise search and agents - which should a 500 person company pick?
Microsoft Copilot or Glean? We care about finding answers across our documents and about who controls the data.
Can I self-host a Copilot-style assistant that can read our SharePoint and our Postgres and take actions?
Microsoft Copilot is 30 dollars a seat on top of our Microsoft 365 plan. What are people using instead?
I want an AI agent platform my team owns, with the agents defined in code and reviewable. What are the options?
How do we get our Copilot Studio agents out of Microsoft's tenant and into something we control?
Which Copilot alternative keeps our data out of a vendor's tenant and still works with our own models?
What are the leading open source AI agent platforms in 2026, and which one is closest to an operating system for agents?
Our team lives in Teams and wants an assistant that can act on tickets and mail without a per seat Microsoft add-on. What exists?
Compare the open source alternatives to Microsoft Copilot Studio for a company that wants to own the whole stack.
